info.title: AI Study Buddy
info.description:
Turns recorded lectures into transcripts, notes, quizzes, flashcards and grounded Q&A.

**Auth:** call `POST /api/auth/login`, copy `access_token`, click **Authorize** and paste it.

All errors use one envelope: `{"error": {"code", "message", "details"}}`.

post.summary: Summary, key takeaways, definitions, topic notes and revision notes (cached)
post.description: Returns the cached result instantly unless `regenerate` is true. Otherwise runs the LLM (Groq free tier by default) synchronously; long lectures use map-reduce and can take a minute or more. Everything is generated from the transcript only; timestamps come from transcript segments.

get.summary: Topic-wise notes with start/end timestamps

post.summary: Generate a quiz from the lecture (answers are hidden until you submit)
post.description: Writes `num_questions` questions of the requested `types` and `difficulty` from the transcript, topic by topic (needs the summary/notes from POST /summarize). Every question is validated (4 unique MCQ options with the answer among them, a real transcript segment, no duplicates); invalid ones are regenerated. Each call creates a new quiz.

get.summary: A quiz without its answers

post.summary: Grade your answers, return explanations and update topic mastery
post.description: MCQ and true/false are graded by rule. Short answers are graded by the LLM against the reference answer and key points; if that fails, by embedding similarity (`graded_by` says which). Each submission is stored as a new attempt.

Definition cards come from the summary's definitions; concept cards are written by the LLM from the transcript. Duplicates are removed. Returns the stored deck unless `regenerate` is true, which replaces the deck and resets its review progress. Needs the summary/notes from POST /summarize.

post.summary: Record knew / didn't know (moves the card between Leitner boxes)
Ask one grounded question about the lecture
post.description: Answers only from this lecture's transcript. The question is embedded (with bge's search prefix), the top RAG_TOP_K chunks are retrieved, and if the best similarity is below RAG_MIN_SCORE the app refuses without calling the LLM. Otherwise the chosen generator answers from the numbered chunks and may still refuse (`answerable: false`) when they don't contain the answer. Source times come from the transcript. A lecture transcribed before indexing existed is indexed on its first question.

post.summary: Multi-turn chat about the lecture (follow-ups are rewritten into standalone questions)
post.description: Answers only from this lecture's transcript. The question is embedded (with bge's search prefix), the top RAG_TOP_K chunks are retrieved, and if the best similarity is below RAG_MIN_SCORE the app refuses without calling the LLM. Otherwise the chosen generator answers from the numbered chunks and may still refuse (`answerable: false`) when they don't contain the answer. Source times come from the transcript. A lecture transcribed before indexing existed is indexed on its first question. Send the returned `session_id` with the next message to continue the conversation.
